H1.quote: Offline use works fully. Each phone caches the full item list, so scanning works without signal.

H2.quote: All data stays on the club's Synology NAS. No third-party cloud or hosted database.

H3.quote: One container, run with **Docker Compose** on the Synology NAS ... Cost: 0 EUR per month.

H4.quote: Every **Monday at 07:00 Europe/Berlin**, the NAS emails the admin an overdue report.

H5.quote: Checking an item out or in takes at most **3 taps and under 15 seconds**, starting from scanning the QR code on the bag.

H6.quote: An on-demand download, with the year chosen by the admin, covering 1 January to 31 December. ... Purpose: the treasurer's yearly inventory for the insurance audit.

H7.quote: for one volunteer football club with about 40 coaches and 300 items

H8.quote: Python with **Flask**. ... The codebase and runbook must be readable by a Python-only successor.

H9.quote: All events, including lost-item records, are purged after **2 years**.

H10.quote: Items expiring **within 30 days** appear in the Monday email ... items expiring within 30 days [on dashboard]

H11.quote: The app never handles money. No deposits, fines or payments, ever.

H12.quote: Deadline: live for the start of the season on **1 March**.
